lines.text: Hmm, I don’t think the Pokémon in your party\nwould work.\c\nCome back again with some different Pokémon!
Wow, your Pokémon is riding on you!\nThat’s super cute!
But I think my Pokémon would be a bit too heavy\nfor me.\c\nThat’s why I have it walk with me instead!
Check your party in the [VAR COLOR(0006)]main menu[VAR COLOR(0000)] and choose\na Pokémon to [VAR COLOR(0006)]take out of its Poké Ball[VAR COLOR(0000)], and it\r\nwill walk around with you!
It’s just adorable to see them!\nHere, let me do it for you!
Just wandering around with your Pokémon can\nbe so much fun!\c\n...But you already know that, right?
